commit.subject: LU-9827 tests: sanityn/80b to wait for background process
commit.message:
LU-9827 tests: sanityn/80b to wait for background process

'kill -9 $migrate_pid' in cleanup_80b() doesn't kill 'lfs migrate',
it kills the subshell only, so we still have our cleanup
procedure (with 'rm -rf') racing with 'lfs migrate'.
use an extra file to signal the subshell to complete.


Fixes: 220e6cbfa65c ("LU-6475 mdt: race between open and migrate")
Signed-off-by: Alex Zhuravlev <bzzz@whamcloud.com>
Assisted-by: ClaudeCode:Opus-5
Change-Id: I32c6abbf3a99a3c9043efe8f395a59c1d4532eb8
